title: [Performance][GLM] Reuse convolution output buffers and remove redundant KDA clears
body:
### What this PR does / why we need it?

Reuse a fixed convolution output buffer across layers in each GLM-5.3 Flash attention group, clearing it once during metadata preparation. Preserve zero decode padding and remove redundant KDA output pre-clears.

### Does this PR introduce _any_ user-facing change?

No API or configuration changes.

### How was this patch tested?

- Existing dispatch/metadata tests, lint and mypy passed in [CI](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/actions/runs/39715018881); CPU tests passed with vLLM main and v0.31.0.
- Selected GDN NPU regressions are running; GLM shared-buffer hardware validation is pending.

Accuracy results supplied for the preceding output-clear removal revision:

| Dataset | PR accuracy | Baseline accuracy |
| --- | --- | --- |
| GPQA-Diamond | 175/198 (88.38%) | 175/198 (88.38%) |
| AIME26 | 29/30 (96.67%) | 29/30 (96.67%) |

- vLLM main: https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/commit/a98247ab4db686ee03c66d5feb3c761e52a2f8ab
